title: Understanding the Role of the Intercept
text: The intercept column in the design matrix X is crucial for the OLS model. It helps in adjusting the predictions to account for the average value of the dependent variable when all other predictors are zero.

title: What Does 'In the Span' Mean?
text: When we say a vector is 'in the span' of a set of vectors, it means that the vector can be expressed as a linear combination of those vectors.
